decisions.decision_value: Selling price set at 25 Euros, profit aim at 50 million Euros, and maximum production cost at 12.50 Euros.
decisions.rationale: Project finance constraints for targeting the international market.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: Our production cost um can be maximal twelve and a half Euros, so that's also a point we have to keep in mind,

decisions.decision_value: Propose making a universal remote control capable of operating TV, DVD player, and video recorder.
decisions.rationale: Users have too many separate remotes at home.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: And I think it's it would be best to just make one remote control that can operate them all.

decisions.decision_value: Remote control should be shockproof and waterproof.
decisions.rationale: Remote controls tend to fall frequently.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: Think it has to be shock proof

decisions.decision_value: Propose adding a battery status display or LED indicator subject to production cost constraints.
decisions.rationale: Allows users to see how much charge is left in the battery.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: Thought it might be handy to put a battery status display on it.

decisions.decision_value: Initially proposed targeting users aged 16 to 45.
decisions.rationale: Ages 16-46 make up 60% of the market and like new functions and fancy designs, whereas 46-65 (40% of the market) are less interested in features.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: And this means we would um have to focus on the age ages sixteen to forty five.

decisions.decision_value: Remote control will operate only the television (TV-only).
decisions.rationale: Multi-device functionality is too complex and would make time-to-market too long.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: we've uh got to design a um remote which is only suitable for T_V_.

decisions.decision_value: Shift target market from 16-45 to 40+ customers per new management requirements.
decisions.rationale: Management mandated targeting 40+ customers because the company is developing another new product specially designed for younger customers.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: because we are going to develop a new product which is specially designed for the younger customers.

decisions.decision_value: Decided to design specifically for elderly users aged 60 to 80 rather than younger users (16-45) or the general 40+ bracket.
decisions.rationale: The company is already developing a separate product specifically for younger customers, older people spend money more easily and represent a large population share, and targeting the 60-80 elderly niche (inspired by the successful elderly mobile phone) is good for company image and market differentiation.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: Now you're talking about sixty to eighty for example.

decisions.decision_value: Keep teletext and add a dedicated button for instant large subtitles despite management suggestion to drop teletext.
decisions.rationale: Users aged 40+/60-80 are unlikely to use TV internet soon, teletext rated high in importance (6.5/10), and deaf/elderly users rely on teletext for subtitles.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: No? Just that, that we just keep the teletext. I think that's a good idea as well, especially for the subtitles.

decisions.decision_value: Include a docking station that recharges the remote and has a button to trigger an audio beep to locate the lost remote.
decisions.rationale: 50% of users reported losing their remote control in the room.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: But it might be a good idea to make a docking station. And this would, could get a button in it

decisions.decision_value: Include a small non-touchscreen LCD display to show extra button explanation/help feedback for elderly users.
decisions.rationale: 34% of users find new remotes hard to learn, and elderly users benefit from a small screen explaining what a button does.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: it might be a good idea to have just a little screen on it, which would explain a button if you press it.

decisions.decision_value: Stick to a basic button layout with standard 1-0 number keys rather than a scroll button.
decisions.rationale: Elderly people are not used to scroll buttons and would have trouble adapting.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: They're not used to using scroll buttons. So perhaps we should s stick to the basic layout.

decisions.decision_value: Confirmed target market of 60 to 80 year old customers.
decisions.rationale: Reconfirmed from Meeting B functional design decisions as the focus for conceptual design.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: And we're going to target uh sixty to to eighty year old customers.

decisions.decision_value: Discard voice/speech recognition.
decisions.rationale: Market research showed the 60-80 target group will not pay extra for speech recognition, it increases production cost significantly, and the docking station already handles finding a lost remote.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: Maybe we have to uh discard the voice recognition. Because it will increase cost uh signifi uh significantly.

decisions.decision_value: Use a standard rechargeable battery charged via the docking station (rejecting kinetic energy, hand dynamo, and solar cells).
decisions.rationale: Older users do not want to shake the remote for kinetic energy, kinetic energy would make the docking station obsolete, and a battery is cheaper.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: but I think just a simple battery which you can reload on a docking station is just as good. And much cheaper as well.

decisions.decision_value: Use an advanced chip.
decisions.rationale: An advanced chip is required to drive the LCD display.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: Well there isn't any choice there because we're using the the the the display. So it's gotta be advanced.

decisions.decision_value: Use plastic casing with changeable covers in wood-look and black/grey.
decisions.rationale: Older people like wood and dark colours; changeable covers allow selling both wood-look and plastic covers on one standard base remote.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: one remote, but it would have to be fancy with either the wood cover or the plastic one.

decisions.decision_value: Single-curved casing with rounded corners, LCD screen at the top, lying flat in the docking station.
decisions.rationale: The single curve angles the top LCD screen toward the user and helps prevent RSI.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: I suggest um the single curved, because maybe the curve is pretty good to put the the screen in.

decisions.decision_value: Replace the 10 number buttons, help button, and mute button with a scroll wheel and 4-5 buttons (power, volume, channel, teletext/subtitles).
decisions.rationale: The 17-button prototype cost 18 Euros, exceeding the 12.50 Euro limit; replacing the 10 number keys and extra buttons with a scroll wheel cuts button costs enough to keep the LCD display and advanced chip.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: Or we can leave out the ten buttons and take one scroll wheel for the programme numbers.

decisions.decision_value: Use the scroll wheel to adjust volume and channel after pressing a single volume or channel button.
decisions.rationale: Saves two additional buttons to meet the 12.50 Euro production budget and makes the scroll wheel function more obvious.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: We could make two buttons out of that. And just um If you press the volume button you can control the volume with the scroll-wheel.

decisions.decision_value: Retain the single-curved plastic case rather than switching to a flat case.
decisions.rationale: Button reductions brought costs within budget so the single-curved case could be kept to highlight the LCD screen.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: I think we can then keep the single curved one. Just to express our L_C_D_ screen a bit more.

decisions.decision_value: Final remote control cost brought under the 12.50 Euro limit (using 1 battery, advanced chip, single-curved plastic case, LCD screen, scroll wheel, and 4 buttons).
decisions.rationale: Reduced battery count from 2 to 1 and reduced buttons from 17 to 4 plus a scroll wheel.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: Are the production costs within the preset limits? Well they are now.

action_items.task_description: Research what elderly people aged 60 to 80 prefer in a remote control.
action_items.resolution_summary: Reported in TS3003c that 60-80 year olds prefer dark colours, recognisable shapes, familiar materials like wood, and a remote that lies flat in the docking station.
action_items.semantic_target_quote: Yeah I think maybe we should do some research into what elderly people like to have in a

disagreements.positions: Speaker D (Marketing Expert) objected to management's requirement to drop teletext and target 40+ instead of 16-45; team resolved to keep teletext (with a subtitles button) and target the 60-80 elderly segment modeled on the elderly mobile phone.
disagreements.semantic_target_quote: So I think it's pretty dumb to put no teletext feature on it. I'm pretty much against it.

disagreements.positions: Speaker D objected that replacing the 10 number buttons with a scroll wheel hurts usability for 60-80 year olds, while Speaker A insisted it was required to stay under the 12.50 Euro budget and Speaker B noted older people recognise tuning knobs from old radios.
disagreements.semantic_target_quote: But then again that would be d j just pretty much not an option for older people, who don't even know what a scroll-wheel is.
